name: Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2019 (EESM19): one subject's 40 Hz ASSR run and 110 s of scored wake
source: OpenNeuro ds005185 v1.0.2, sub-001 ses-001: task-ASSR (40 Hz amplitude-modulated noise) and task-sleep PSG
attribution: Mikkelsen, K. B., Kidmose, P., & Rezaei Tabar, Y. Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2019 (EESM19), Aarhus University. OpenNeuro ds005185, CC0.
reduction: reduce.py: channel F3. ASSR 130–240 s: one Hann FFT, 20–60 Hz, spectral F-tests. Welch spectra fitted with specparam for the ASSR run and the wake window. Time-reversal asymmetry of 30 s of wake against FT, AAFT and IAAFT surrogates, and of a phase-randomised copy as the linear control.
